title: A Year of Rain
brief: Turn my monthly observations into a restrained data-art print: twelve concentric calendar rings, with rainfall controlling each arc. Include the actual values and the place. Deliver a wall print, a square card and a landscape legend, using my pasted CSV rather than synthetic numbers.
notes: The example CSV is an explicitly invented acceptance fixture. Replace it with your observations. The artwork shows the supplied values without claiming these are historical measurements.
